TORC1 の基質 Sch9 が Amd1 をリン酸化する候補のキナーゼ（259: The TORC1 substrate Sch9 is a candidate kinase that phosphorylates Amd1 (25921291)
TORC1 の基質 Sch9 が転写抑制因子 Dot6・Tod6・Stb3 を直: The TORC1 substrate Sch9 directly phosphorylates and inhibits the transcriptional repressors Dot6, Tod6, and Stb3
TORC1 の標的 Sfp1 は、並行して働くもう一つの標的 Sch9 の TO: The TORC1 target Sfp1 negatively regulates TORC1-mediated phosphorylation of Sch9, another TORC1 target acting in parallel (19328065)
TORC1 の阻害が細胞壁の性質を変え、Wsc1・Wsc3・Wsc4 を通じて: TORC1 inhibition alters cell wall properties and activates the CWI pathway (Mpk1) through Wsc1, Wsc3, and Wsc4 (38949052)
TORC1 の阻害で酵母の 19S 組み立てシャペロンとプロテアソームサブユニッ: TORC1 inhibition induces all yeast 19S assembly chaperones and proteasome subunits (27462806). Main text: TORC1 inhibition induces Adc17 and increases proteasomes
TORC1 の阻害の下流で Mpk1 が RAC とプロテアソームサブユニットの: Downstream of TORC1 inhibition, Mpk1 increases the supply of RACs and proteasome subunits (27462806; main text: Adc17 induction requires Mpk1 signaling). TORC1 inhibition increases Adc17 translation, which depends on Mpk1 activation (38949052)

TORC1 は 5S rDNA のクロマチンに結合し、Pol III の抑制因子: TORC1 binds 5S rDNA chromatin and controls phosphorylation of the Pol III repressor Maf1 and its binding to Pol III genes. TORC1 prevents Maf1 translocation to the nucleolus, binds Maf1 in vivo, and phosphorylates Maf1 in vitro (19574957). Classified as inhibition because it blocks Maf1's repressive function

In the main text, Ypk3 becomes hypophosphorylated with rapamycin, carbon source shifts, and nitrogen starvation; TORC1 phosphorylates Ypk3 in vitro, and Ypk3 purified from rapamycin-treated cells has reduced activity. Ypk3 with four C-terminal sites replaced by A cannot phosphorylate Rps6
TORC1 は Cbk1 のリン酸化を通して細胞質分裂後の細胞分離を抑える。T5: TORC1 inhibits cell separation after cytokinesis via Cbk1 phosphorylation. A T574 phosphomimetic Cbk1 is inactive and recapitulates TORC1-mediated inhibition of cell separation (37647291). The main text says "directly or indirectly", so the direct field is left blank
TORC1 は Rpd3 による Ino80 K929 と H2A.Z の脱アセ: TORC1 enhances Rpd3-mediated deacetylation of Ino80 K929 and H2A.Z; when TORC1 is inactivated by nitrogen starvation or rapamycin, Rpd3L is inhibited and autophagy is induced (36888706)
TORC1 は Ypk3 と Glc7 を介して Rps6 の S232/S23: TORC1 regulates phosphorylation of Rps6 S232/S233 via Ypk3 and Glc7, and TORC2 regulates S232 via Ypk1 (26582391)
TORC1 は試験管内で Scd6 をリン酸化し（kog1-105 やラパマイシ: TORC1 phosphorylates Scd6 in vitro (reduced with TORC1 from kog1-105 or rapamycin-treated cells), mainly at S256, S280, and S287. Scd6 activity is inhibited by TORC1-mediated phosphorylation (33566094)
TORC1-Sch9 の経路はセラミダーゼ遺伝子 YDC1・YPC1 の発現を抑: The TORC1-Sch9 pathway represses the ceramidase genes YDC1 and YPC1 (24196832)
TORC1-Sch9 経路はセラミダーゼ遺伝子 YDC1 と YPC1 の発現を: The TORC1-Sch9 pathway represses expression of the ceramidase genes YDC1 and YPC1 (24196832)
TORC2 が Pkc1 の Thr1125・Ser1143 をリン酸化し、TO: TORC2 phosphorylates Pkc1 at Thr1125 and Ser1143, and TORC2–Pkc1 signaling activates the Pkc1–Mpk1 MAPK cascade
TORC2 の標的 Ypk1 は Msn2・Msn4 を抑えることで ATG8: The TORC2 target Ypk1 controls ATG8 expression by inhibiting Msn2 and Msn4. Msn2 and Msn4 promote ATG8 expression downstream of Ume6 (29198169)
TPI の 5' 非翻訳領域に Gcr1 の結合部位が 2 つあり、両方の変異で: The TPI 5' untranslated region contains two Gcr1 binding sites, and mutating both reduces reporter expression 68-fold (8417350). TPI transcripts are greatly reduced in gcr1 mutants (2263469)
TPI の上流の RAP1 結合部位の変異でレポーターの発現が 10 分の 1: Mutating the RAP1 binding site upstream of TPI reduces reporter expression 10-fold (8417350)
TPK1 プロモーターは熱ショックと塩ストレスで活性化され、Msn2/4・Gis: The TPK1 promoter is activated by heat shock and salt stress, and Msn2/4, Gis1, and Sok2 are involved in regulating TPK1 expression under stress (24530423). Heat shock evicts nucleosomes from the TPK1 promoter and increases TPK1 mRNA, and SWI/SNF is recruited to the promoter in a Msn2/4-dependent manner (32599085)
TPO1 の小胞体から細胞膜への選別は、cAMP 依存性プロテインキナーゼ 1: Sorting of TPO1 from the ER to the plasma membrane is enhanced by S342 phosphorylation by cAMP-dependent protein kinases 1 and 2 (15637075)
TPO1 の輸送活性は、プロテインキナーゼ C による S19 と casein: TPO1 transport activity is enhanced by phosphorylation of S19 by protein kinase C and of T52 by casein kinase 1. S342 phosphorylation by PKA (TPK1, TPK2) enhances sorting from the ER to the plasma membrane (15637075)
TPO3 は Haa1 に活性化される遺伝子で、Haa1 はそのプロモーターの: TPO3 is a Haa1-activated gene, and Haa1 binds the ACRE in its promoter in vivo (21586585)
TRAPP II のサブユニット Trs130 は Ypt6 の GAP である: The TRAPP II subunit Trs130 acts to recruit Gyp6, a GAP for Ypt6, to Golgi membranes. TRAPP II mutants are defective in Gyp6 binding, and as a result Ypt6 localization to the late Golgi is enhanced (27252941)
TRAPPII 特有の Trs120 と Trs130 は TRAPP の GE: The TRAPPII-specific Trs120 and Trs130 are required to switch the GEF specificity of TRAPP from Ypt1 to Ypt31 (17041589)
TRAPPIII と Atg2 が隔離膜と小胞体出口部位の接触をつくり Ypt1: TRAPPIII and Atg2 establish contacts between the isolation membrane and ER exit sites and activate Ypt1. Ypt1 spreads over the entire isolation membrane and promotes its expansion through local PI3P synthesis and recruitment of Atg18 and Atg21 (40775526)
TRAPPIII と Atg2 は隔離膜と小胞体出口部位の結合、TRAPPIII: TRAPPIII and Atg2 are equally essential for linking the isolation membrane to ER exit sites, activating TRAPPIII, and activating Ypt1 on the isolation membrane (40775526). Main text: Atg2 binding to Atg9 is required to enhance TRAPPIII GEF activity at the isolation membrane
TRAPPIII はオートファジーに特異的な Ypt1 の GEF で、Trs8: TRAPPIII is an autophagy-specific GEF for Ypt1, and the Trs85 subunit directs this GEF to the PAS (20375281). Trs85 binds Atg9 directly, and Trs85-containing TRAPPIII loads Ypt1 onto Atg9 vesicles (23129774)
TYR1 の発現は GCN4 の一般制御を受けないらしく、フェニルアラニンの有無: TYR1 expression appears not to be under GCN4 general control and depends on the presence of phenylalanine (2697638) (PMID: 2697638)
TYW1-4 がワイブトシン合成に必須。yW-187 からの多段階の反応を TY: TYW1-4 are essential for wybutosine synthesis. The multistep reaction from yW-187 was reconstituted with TYW2, TYW3, and TYW4 (16642040)
Taf2 の結合で Taf14 のリンカーが露出し DNA・ヌクレオソームに結合: Taf2 binding exposes the Taf14 linker, allowing it to bind DNA and nucleosomes (35676274). Taf2 and Taf14 bind directly (27587401)
Taf9 の CRD は Taf9-Taf6 の結合・TFIID と SAGA: The Taf9 CRD is not required for Taf9-Taf6 binding or for TFIID and SAGA integrity, but is required for TFIID and SAGA binding to promoters (24550006)
Tah1 は Ure2 と相互作用し、[URE3] 株で Ure2 の可溶性を高: Tah1 interacts with Ure2, increases Ure2 solubility in [URE3] strains, and affects the rate of fibrillization in vitro (33811921)
Tam41 は内膜の TIM23 複合体の構造の維持に関わる。tam41Δ で: Tam41 is involved in maintaining the structure of the inner-membrane TIM23 complex. The TIM23 complex deteriorates in tam41Δ and is partially restored by Art5 overexpression (20074554)
Tbf1 は snoRNA 以外のプロモーターで、Tbf1 と相互作用する Vi: At non-snoRNA promoters, Tbf1 colocalizes with its interactors Vid22 and Ygr071c (20513435)
Tca17 は TRAPPII の 4 つ目の特異的成分で、Trs65 と Tc: Tca17 is the fourth TRAPPII-specific component, and Trs65 and Tca17 bind different domains of Trs130 (21453443)
Tcb2 の C 末端は Y2H で Tcb1・Tcb3 の C 末端と結合し、: The Tcb2 C-terminus binds the C-termini of Tcb1 and Tcb3 in Y2H, and they are thought to form heterodimers (15141306)
Tcb2 は Y2H で転写因子 Pdr1 の活性化ドメインと相互作用した（15: Tcb2 interacted with the activation domain of the transcription factor Pdr1 in Y2H (15141306)
Tcp1p の過剰発現が act1-1・act1-4 の増殖不良を一部抑える。T: Overexpression of Tcp1p partially suppresses the growth defects of act1-1 and act1-4. Tcp1p is required for actin and microtubule function (7865875)
Tdh1・Tdh2 が GFP-Tdh3 と共精製され、この結びつきがないと T: Tdh1 and Tdh2 copurify with GFP-Tdh3, and without this association Tdh3 aggregation increases (31743950)
Tdh1・Tdh2 は Tdh3 と共精製され、この結合がないと Tdh3 が凝: Tdh1 and Tdh2 copurify with Tdh3, and without this binding Tdh3 is more prone to aggregation (31743950)
Tdh3 は Scd6 の翻訳抑制を促す。Scd6 と Hmt1 の結合を促し、: Tdh3 promotes translational repression by Scd6. It promotes binding of Scd6 to Hmt1, enhancing methylation and binding to eIF4G1 (39093296)
Tdp1 は TOP1-DNA の共有結合中間体を除き、酵母でその働きに N 末: Tdp1 removes covalent TOP1-DNA intermediates, and in yeast its N-terminal domain is important for this function (36697463)
Tec1 と Ste12 は Msa1・Msa2 と結合し、Msa1/2 は T: Tec1 and Ste12 bind Msa1 and Msa2, and Msa1/2 act as coactivators that enhance the transcriptional activity of Tec1-Ste12 (24732795)
Tec1 と Ste12 は Msa1・Msa2 と結合する。Msa1/2 は: Tec1 and Ste12 bind Msa1 and Msa2. Msa1/2 enhance the transcriptional activity of Tec1-Ste12 (24732795)
Tel1 と Mec1 は Rap1 の S731 をリン酸化し、このリン酸化は: Tel1 and Mec1 phosphorylate Rap1 at S731, and this phosphorylation increases with DNA damage and telomere shortening. Impaired phosphorylation weakens Rap1 binding to Rif1 and disrupts end protection (28575419). Confidence is medium because the contributions of Tel1 and Mec1 are not separated
Tel1 の変異体 Tel1-400 は DSB に多く集まり DNA 損傷で起: The Tel1 mutant Tel1-400 accumulates strongly at DSBs, enhances DNA damage-induced Rad9 phosphorylation, and promotes tethering of broken ends via phosphorylation-dependent Rad9 oligomerization (42755364)
Tel1 は Cdc13 のテロメラーゼ呼び込み領域を S225・S249・S2: Tel1 phosphorylates the telomerase recruitment domain of Cdc13 at S225, S249, and S255 in vitro (Mec1 also at S306), and mutating the SQ motifs causes telomere and growth defects (17108359)
Tel1 は Xrs2 の C 末端に依存して DSB に結合する（129230: Tel1 binds DSBs in a manner dependent on the Xrs2 C-terminus (12923051). The Tel1-binding activity of the Xrs2 C-terminus recruits Tel1 to DSB ends (26990569). MRX recruits Tel1 to DSBs through direct binding of Tel1 to Xrs2 and is required for Tel1 activation (30698745)
Tel2 は Tel1 に結合し、Tel1 の量が多くてもこの結合が DNA 切: Tel2 binds Tel1, and even when Tel1 levels are high, this binding is required for Tel1 accumulation at DNA break sites and activation of downstream targets. Tel2 is structurally similar to Ddc2 (ATRIP) (18334620)
Ten1 は Stn1 と Cdc13 の両方と物理的に結合する（1123014: Ten1 physically binds both Stn1 and Cdc13 (11230140)
Tfb2 は Ssl2 ヘリカーゼと NER 特異的な Tfb5 を橋渡しする（: Tfb2 bridges the Ssl2 helicase and the NER-specific Tfb5 (19897425)
Tfb5 は TFIIH コアの Tfb2 と結合し、その結合が細胞の NER: Tfb5 binds the TFIIH core subunit Tfb2, and this binding correlates with cellular NER function (17215295)
Tfb6 は Ssl2 とヘテロ二量体として TFIIH から解離する（2241: Tfb6 dissociates from TFIIH as a heterodimer with Ssl2 (22411836)
Tfc4 の TPR7 の変異 L469K で Brf1 の TFIIIB-TF: The L469K mutation in TPR7 of Tfc4 reduces recruitment of Brf1 to the TFIIIB-TFIIIC-DNA complex and direct Tfc4-Brf1 binding (12930823)
Tfg2p は Kap104p の基質で、PY-NLS を介して核へ運ばれる（1: Tfg2p is a Kap104p substrate and is transported into the nucleus via a PY-NLS (19366694)
Tfs1 は CPY と Ira2 の両方を阻害する二重の働きをもち、片方だけを: Tfs1 has a dual function, inhibiting both CPY and Ira2; from the phenotypes of mutants lacking only one of these, inhibition of Ira2 is the main function under the conditions tested (19552705)
Tfs1 は NatB の基質で、アセチル化されない Tfs1 は CPY の阻: Tfs1 is a NatB substrate, and non-acetylated Tfs1 is about 100-fold weaker at inhibiting CPY. Caffeine-induced growth inhibition is suppressed in tfs1Δ, but this suppression disappears in a nat3Δ background (15229224)
Tgl2 はミトコンドリア膜間腔に局在し、Mia40 のジスルフィド中継系で取り: Tgl2 localizes to the mitochondrial intermembrane space and is imported by the Mia40 disulfide relay system (31483742)
Tgl4 は Cdk1/Cdc28 にリン酸化され活性化され、その脂肪分解が G: Tgl4 is phosphorylated and activated by Cdk1/Cdc28, and its lipolysis contributes to early budding in late G1 (19150427). Tgl4 is dephosphorylated upon entry into G1 and appears to be inactivated in G1 (35981421)
Thg1p は生体内・試験管内で ORC と結合し、HA-Thg1p の過剰発現: Thg1p binds ORC in vivo and in vitro, and overexpression of HA-Thg1p impairs growth of orc2-1(Ts) even at the permissive temperature (15821142)
Thi2 と Thi3 は互いに結合し、外からのチアミンで結合が弱まる。複合体と: Thi2 and Thi3 bind each other, and exogenous thiamine weakens the binding. As a complex they induce THI genes (16194233)
Tho1 は THO と RNA に依存して転写中のクロマチンに結合し、シャトル: Tho1 binds transcribed chromatin in a THO- and RNA-dependent manner and genetically interacts with the shuttling hnRNP Nab2 (16738307)
Tho2 をタグで精製すると Tho2・Hpr1・Mft1・Thp2 の複合体が: Tag purification of Tho2 yields a complex of Tho2, Hpr1, Mft1, and Thp2, and immunoprecipitation with anti-Mft1 antibody also recovers Hpr1 and Tho2 (11060033)
Thp3 と Csn12 は複合体を作り、転写中の遺伝子へ呼び込まれる（2114: Thp3 and Csn12 form a complex and are recruited to transcribed genes (21149575)
Ths1 は Cdc48-20S プロテアソームの内在の基質。精製した Ths1: Ths1 is an endogenous substrate of the Cdc48-20S proteasome. Purified Ths1 binds Cdc48 directly and is degraded without ubiquitination (31954512)
Tif6 の 60S からの解離に GTPase Efl1 が要る（206708: Release of Tif6 from 60S requires the GTPase Efl1 (20670889). Dominant TIF6 mutations suppress the growth defects of ria1 C-terminal truncations and deletions (11713675)
Tim17 の TM1・TM2 の変異で Tim23 との相互作用が損なわれ、T: Mutations in TM1 and TM2 of Tim17 impair interaction with Tim23, and mutations in TM3 impair binding to the import motor (28165323)
Tim21 は Tom22 の膜間腔ドメインに結合して TOM と TIM23: Tim21 binds the intermembrane-space domain of Tom22, directly linking the TOM and TIM23 complexes (17099692)
Tim50 は Tim23 の膜間腔の部分と結合し、この結合は内膜を越える輸送に: Tim50 binds the intermembrane-space portion of Tim23, and this binding is essential for transport across the inner membrane. Temperature-sensitive Tim50 mutations impair binding to Tim23 (30765764)
Tim54・Tim22 は Tim18 と共免疫沈降し、約 300 kDa の複: Tim54 and Tim22 co-immunoprecipitate with Tim18 and are detected together in a complex of about 300 kDa (10637294)
Tim8-Tim13 複合体は 6 量体で、基質 Tim23 に結合して膜間腔を: The Tim8-Tim13 complex is a hexamer that acts as a chaperone binding the substrate Tim23 and carrying it across the intermembrane space (18706423)
Tim8-Tim13 複合体は Tim23 に結合して膜間腔を運ぶ。表面プラズモ: The Tim8-Tim13 complex binds Tim23 and carries it across the intermembrane space. Surface plasmon resonance showed about six binding sites and cooperative binding (18706423)
Tim9 の内側のジスルフィド結合を失うと Tim9・Tim10 が分解され温度: Loss of the inner disulfide bond of Tim9 leads to degradation of Tim9 and Tim10 and temperature sensitivity; loss of Yme1 restores growth and stabilizes Tim10 (26182355). Reconstituted Yme1 degrades Tim10 faster than Tim9, and degradation accelerates when the disulfide bonds are broken (28214511)
Tld1 欠損では脂肪滴の形成は正常だが、リパーゼ Tgl3 に依存した TG: In Tld1-deficient cells, lipid droplet formation is normal, but TG breakdown dependent on the lipase Tgl3 increases (37889293)
Tlg1 がないとき Syn8 は Pep12 の働きに必要。Tlg1 があれば: In the absence of Tlg1, Syn8 is required for Pep12 function. When Tlg1 is present, Pep12 functions even without Syn8 (12453154)
Tma20/Tma22 のヘテロ二量体が 40S リサイクルの大部分を担い、Tm: The Tma20/Tma22 heterodimer accounts for most 40S recycling, and the contribution of Tma64 is small (34016977)
Tma23 は Prp43 を活性化する G-patch をもつが、I-patc: Tma23 has a G-patch that activates Prp43 but also inhibits Prp43 ATPase via its I-patch (39578461)
Toa1 の N 末の 4 ヘリックス束は Toa2 との二量体化に要る（379: The N-terminal four-helix bundle of Toa1 is required for dimerization with Toa2 (37947853)
Toa2 の Y69・W76 の置換で TFIIA が TBP のプロモーター結: Substitutions at Y69 and W76 of Toa2 prevent TFIIA from promoting TBP binding to promoters (9566876)
Tof2 の量は SLX5 の欠失や SIM の破壊で回復し、Tof2 は SU: Tof2 levels are restored by SLX5 deletion or SIM disruption, and Tof2 is degraded in a SUMO- and STUbL-dependent manner (28487408)
Tog1 は糖新生の PCK1・FBP1 の直接の活性化因子（24998441）: Tog1 is a direct activator of the gluconeogenic genes PCK1 and FBP1 (24998441)
Toh1 の凝集体は Sup35NM の凝集体と共局在し FRET で結合する（: Toh1 aggregates colocalize with Sup35NM aggregates and interact by FRET (30558459)

Tom1 と Dia2 は G1 期の Cdc6 の分解を制御し、SCF(Cdc: Tom1 and Dia2 control Cdc6 degradation in G1, acting independently of SCF(Cdc4). Cdc6 ubiquitination decreases in tom1Δ (23129771)
Tom1 は G1 期と G2/M 期に Dia2 のユビキチン化と分解に要る。: Tom1 is required for Dia2 ubiquitination and degradation in G1 and G2/M. Tom1 recognizes positively charged residues in the degron/NLS region of Dia2 (22933573)
Tom7 は Mdm10 を SAM(holo) 複合体から低分子量の形に分離さ: Tom7 promotes separation of Mdm10 from the SAM(holo) complex into a low-molecular-weight form (16760475)
Tom70 と Tom71 は Mfb1 のミトコンドリア局在に必要。Mfb1: Tom70 and Tom71 are required for mitochondrial localization of Mfb1. Mfb1 interacts with Tom71 in vivo (18007655)
Top1 の活性がないと Top1 自身と Tri1（YMR233W）の SUM: Without Top1 activity, SUMOylation of Top1 itself and of Tri1 (YMR233W) increases (17603101)
Top2 の C 末端の SUMO 化は体内でも試験管内でも Siz1 と Si: SUMOylation of the Top2 C-terminus is mediated by Siz1 and Siz2 both in vivo and in vitro. The minichromosome segregation defect of cells lacking SUMO E3s is due to the absence of Top2 SUMOylation (16204216)

Tor1 は Gln3 と結合し、TOR のキナーゼドメインが Gln3 のリン: Tor1 binds Gln3, and the TOR kinase domain is required for Gln3 phosphorylation, blocking its nuclear translocation, and repressing transcription. Meanwhile, a phosphatase dependent on Pph3 and Tap42 is involved in Gln3 activation (10940301)

Trx1 と Trx2 は同じくらいチオレドキシンペルオキシダーゼ Tsa1 の: Trx1 and Trx2 act equally well as cofactors of the thioredoxin peroxidase Tsa1. The requirement for thioredoxin in stationary phase is due to its role as a Tsa1 cofactor (11929546)
Trz1–Nuc1–ムタロターゼの安定な 6 量体で、Nuc1 の活性はムタロタ: Trz1, Nuc1, and mutarotase form a stable hexamer; Nuc1 activity is fully inhibited by mutarotase and partially by Trz1 (28899942)

Tsr1 と Dim1 は Rio2・Nob1・Dim2 のまとまりに周辺でつな: Tsr1 and Dim1 are peripherally connected to the Rio2-Nob1-Dim2 module. Main text: Rio2 binds Tsr1 directly (21283762)

Tsr4 は翻訳と同時に Rps2 に結合し（N 末端の伸長部が必要）、Tsr4: Tsr4 binds Rps2 cotranslationally (requiring the N-terminal extension), and impairing Tsr4 reduces Rps2 levels (31182640)
Tti2 を減らすと Tra1・Mec1・Tor1 の量が減り、局在が変わり、そ: Depleting Tti2 reduces the levels of Tra1, Mec1, and Tor1, alters their localization, and impairs their respective stress responses (27172216)
Tub1 と Tub3 はそれぞれ Dyn1 経路と Kar9 経路の要素を呼び: Tub1 and Tub3 recruit components of the Dyn1 and Kar9 pathways, respectively, to optimize spindle positioning. Main text: without Tub3, plus-end accumulation of Bim1 and Kar9 decreases (34739032)
Tul1 E3 リガーゼは Tul1・Dsc2・Dsc3・Ubx3 からなり、働: The Tul1 E3 ligase consists of Tul1, Dsc2, Dsc3, and Ubx3, and each subunit is required for its function (25078903)

Tup1 と Nhp6B の直接の結合を共沈降で確認（11095729）: Direct binding between Tup1 and Nhp6B was confirmed by coprecipitation (11095729)

Tup1 は HMLalpha1 プロモーターへの TBP・Pol II・TFI: Tup1 blocks recruitment of TBP, Pol II, and TFIIH to the HMLalpha1 promoter, preventing preinitiation complex formation (18391020)
Tup1–Cyc8 は Sko1 に呼ばれて Sko1 依存の遺伝子 GRE2・: Tup1–Cyc8 is recruited by Sko1 and represses the Sko1-dependent genes GRE2 and AHP1 under normal, unstressed conditions (repression is relieved by mutation)
Tus1 の働きと局在は Tus1 と結合する Ypl066w（Rgl1）に大き: The function and localization of Tus1 depend largely on its binding partner Ypl066w (Rgl1) (22344253)
Tus1（Rho1 の GEF）は Cln2-Cdc28 と結合し、Cln2-C: Tus1 (a Rho1 GEF) binds Cln2-Cdc28 and is phosphorylated in a Cln2-Cdc28-dependent manner. The CDK sites are required for Rho1 activation at G1/S and for actin polarity (18256282)
Tvp23 は Tlg2 を含む区画に局在し、免疫沈降で Yip4・Yip5 と: Tvp23 localizes to Tlg2-containing compartments and forms an interaction network with Yip4 and Yip5 by immunoprecipitation (17178117)
Tyc1 は APC/C に結合して APC/C-Cdc20 と APC/C-C: Tyc1 binds the APC/C, inhibits APC/C-Cdc20 and APC/C-Cdh1 activity in vitro, and prevents Cdc20 and Cdh1 binding to the APC/C (29883473)
U1 snRNP のクライオ電顕構造で、補助タンパク質は Prp42/Prp39: In the cryo-EM structure of the U1 snRNP, the auxiliary proteins are connected to the core via Prp42/Prp39 (29051543)

UAF は RRN5・RRN9・RRN10 がコードするタンパク質を含む多タンパ: UAF is a multiprotein transcription factor containing the proteins encoded by RRN5, RRN9, and RRN10 (8846924)
UAF は RRN5・RRN9・RRN10 にコードされる 3 つのタンパク質を: UAF is a multiprotein transcription factor containing three proteins encoded by RRN5, RRN9, and RRN10 (8846924)
UAF は Rrn5p・Rrn9p・Rrn10p・H3・H4 と p30 からな: UAF consists of Rrn5p, Rrn9p, Rrn10p, H3, H4, and p30, and the p30 gene was identified as UAF30 (11500378)
UBI4 の熱ショック誘導は HSE と STRE が独立に担い、HSF・Msn: Heat shock induction of UBI4 is mediated independently by HSEs and STREs; it is induced when either HSF or Msn2/4 is missing, and greatly reduced when both are missing (10048026)

UGA など窒素異化の遺伝子は Gln3 に正に、Dal80 に負に調節される。: UGA and other nitrogen catabolic genes are positively regulated by Gln3 and negatively by Dal80. The GATA sites upstream of UGA4 are required for Gln3 activation and also mediate Dal80 binding and response (8045902)
UGA1・UGA2・UGA4 の GABA による誘導には Uga3 と Uga: GABA induction of UGA1, UGA2, and UGA4 requires two positive transcription factors, Uga3 and Uga35/Dal81 (21708130)

UPC2 に応答し嫌気条件でも誘導される 9 遺伝子を同定し、そのうち AUS1: Nine genes responsive to UPC2 and also induced under anaerobic conditions were identified; deletion of AUS1, PDR11, or DAN1 among them reduces sterol uptake (12077145)
UPF3 を欠くと Atg16 が増え、オートファジーが亢進。ATG16 は N: Loss of UPF3 increases Atg16 and enhances autophagy. ATG16 appears to be an NMD target (41668711)

UPR を誘導する薬剤で GPC1 の mRNA が Hac1 依存に増える（3: UPR-inducing drugs increase GPC1 mRNA in a Hac1-dependent manner (37269946)

Uba4 で活性化された Urm1 のチオカルボキシ基が Ncs2/Ncs6 に: The thiocarboxylate of Urm1 activated by Uba4 is used for 2-thiouridine formation by Ncs2/Ncs6 (19151091)

Ubp10 は核小体にあり、ubp10Δ では pre-rRNA・成熟 rRNA: Ubp10 is nucleolar, and in ubp10Δ pre-rRNA, mature rRNA, and translating ribosomes decrease. The largest subunit of RNA polymerase I (Rpa190) is stabilized by Ubp10-mediated deubiquitination, which is required for ribosome levels and growth (22902402)
Ubp12 は Fzo1 を安定にし融合を促すユビキチン鎖を認識して外す（233: Ubp12 recognizes and removes ubiquitin chains that stabilize Fzo1 and promote fusion (23317502). In ubp3 mutants, Ubp12, which removes fusion-required polyubiquitin chains from Fzo1, is stabilized (29924334)

Ubp15 は Pex1/Pex6 複合体の構成要素で、Pex5 からユビキチン: Ubp15 is a component of the Pex1/Pex6 complex and can remove ubiquitin from Pex5. Its deletion reduces PTS1 import under stress (21665945)

Ubp2 と Ubp15 を欠くと Art4 が不安定になり Hxt6 のエンド: Loss of Ubp2 and Ubp15 destabilizes Art4 and impairs Hxt6 endocytosis (28298493)
Ubp2 は Fzo1 の分解を始め融合を止めるユビキチン鎖を外す（233175: Ubp2 removes ubiquitin chains that initiate Fzo1 degradation and block fusion (23317502). Ubp2 counteracts Mdm30-mediated Fzo1 degradation (28607491)
Ubp2 は Mdm30 による Fzo1 の分解に逆らい、Mdm30 は Ub: Ubp2 counteracts Mdm30-mediated Fzo1 degradation, and Mdm30 targets Ubp2 for degradation, triggering Rsp5-mediated fatty acid desaturation (28607491)
Ubp2 は Rup1 を介して Rsp5 と結合し、Rsp5 と拮抗する（ub: Ubp2 binds Rsp5 via Rup1 and antagonizes Rsp5 (ubp2Δ and rup1Δ suppress rsp5-1, and Ubp2 reverses ubiquitination of Rsp5 substrates) (15933713). Ubp2 removes Rsp5 autoubiquitination in vivo and in vitro (24069405)
Ubp3 は Bre5 と組んではじめて活性のある脱ユビキチン化複合体になり、特: Ubp3 becomes an active deubiquitinating complex only when paired with Bre5, removing ubiquitin from specific substrates (12778054)
Ubp3 は RNAPII、Def1、Spt5、TFIIF と一緒に精製され、試: Ubp3 copurifies with RNAPII, Def1, Spt5, and TFIIF, and deubiquitinates mono- and polyubiquitinated RNAPII in vitro. Ubp3 は補因子 Bre5 と活性のある脱ユビキチン化複合体をつくり、COPI: Ubp3 forms an active deubiquitinating complex with its cofactor Bre5 and rescues the COPII component Sec23 from proteasomal degradation (12778054). Sec23 ubiquitination is mediated by Rsp5 (20846524)
Ubp6 はプロテアソームの基部とサブユニット Rpn1 を認識する。プロテアソ: Ubp6 recognizes the proteasome base and the subunit Rpn1. Binding to the proteasome activates Ubp6 300-fold (12408819)

Vac7 and Vac14 independently regulate Fab1 activity (16492811)
UniProt の向きと一致。Vac7 と Vac14 は独立に Fab1 の活: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Vac7 and Vac14 independently regulate Fab1 activity (abstract). In the main text, Vac7 is the main activator of Fab1 and further activates Fab1 upon hyperosmotic shock (16492811). In vac7 deletion, PI(3,5)P2 is nearly undetectable (11950935)
UniProt の向きと一致。Vma13 は Ynd1 の細胞質ドメインに結合し: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Vma13 binds the cytoplasmic domain of Ynd1, and vma13 deletion greatly increases the ADP-hydrolyzing activity of membrane Ynd1. The presence of Vma13, not V-ATPase function, inhibits Ynd1 activity (10954728)
UniProt の向きと一致。sec14(ts) を 37 度に移すと Nte1: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Shifting sec14(ts) to 37°C reduces Nte1-dependent intracellular GPCho accumulation, and Sec14 acts as a positive regulator of PC deacylation by Nte1 (15611060)
UniProt の向きと一致。精製 Sst2 は Gpa1 の GTP 加水分解: Consistent with the UniProt direction. Sst2 is the main in vivo regulator of Gpa1-mediated signaling, and sst2 deletion increases pheromone sensitivity (16467474)
Upc2 と Ecm22 は ERG2 を含む ERG 遺伝子のプロモーターに結: Upc2 and Ecm22 bind the promoters of ERG genes including ERG2 and activate them upon sterol depletion (16055745)
Upf1 との結合を壊す Nmd2 の変異は NMD を失わせる（8601282: Nmd2 mutations that disrupt binding to Upf1 abolish NMD (8601282)
Ups1 は Mgm1 の特別なプロセシングと正常なミトコンドリアの形に必要（1: Ups1 is required for the specific processing of Mgm1 and normal mitochondrial morphology (16754953)
Ups1 は Yme1 とメタロペプチダーゼ Atp23 の両方で分解される（2: Ups1 is degraded by both Yme1 and the metallopeptidase Atp23 (20657548)

Ure2 は Gln3 に直接作用して転写活性化を妨げる。TOR 依存のリン酸化: Ure2 acts directly on Gln3 to block transcriptional activation. TOR-dependent phosphorylation causes GLN3 to bind URE2 and remain in the cytoplasm
Ure2 は Gln3・Gat1 の局在と転写活性化を抑え、窒素が十分な細胞で: Ure2 inhibits the localization and transcriptional activation of Gln3 and Gat1 and is thought to retain them in the cytoplasm as Ure2-Gat1 complexes in nitrogen-replete cells (23184930)
Ure2/Gln3 が窒素カタボライト抑制を通じて IRC7 の転写を制御する（: Ure2/Gln3 control IRC7 transcription through nitrogen catabolite repression (18462383)
Urm1・Uba4・Tum1・Ncs2・Ncs6 が 2-チオ化に必要。Urm1: Urm1, Uba4, Tum1, Ncs2, and Ncs6 are required for 2-thiolation. The Urm1 thiocarboxylate is used in the reaction by Ncs2/Ncs6 (19151091)
Urn1 は Prp19 と直接相互作用し、U2・U5・U6 snRNA やスプ: Urn1 interacts directly with Prp19 and copurifies with U2, U5, and U6 snRNAs and splicing factors (21386897)
Usa1 の C 末端に Der1 が結合し、可溶性基質の分解に要る（20005: Der1 binds the C-terminus of Usa1, which is required for degradation of soluble substrates (20005842)
Usa1 の N 末端は Hrd1 と結合して Der1 と Hrd1 をつなぎ: The N-terminus of Usa1 binds Hrd1, linking Der1 and Hrd1 and inducing oligomerization of the HRD complex (a prerequisite for membrane protein degradation) (20005842)
Utp12p:Utp13p のヘテロ二量体が Pwp2p・Utp21p の C: The Utp12p:Utp13p heterodimer is incorporated into UTP-B via the C-termini of Pwp2p and Utp21p (28600509)
Utp22 と Rrp7 の共結晶構造。Rrp7 は変形した RRM とリンカー: Co-crystal structure of Utp22 and Rrp7. Rrp7 binds Utp22 extensively via a distorted RRM and a linker (24130456)
Utp22 は Tys1 と直接結合し、Tys1 が tRNA と結合していると: Utp22 binds Tys1 directly, and binding is enhanced when Tys1 is bound to tRNA (23194188)
Utp25 の DUF1253 ドメインが Utp3（Sas10）との結合に必要: The DUF1253 domain of Utp25 is necessary and sufficient for binding to Utp3 (Sas10) (20884785)
Utp25 は SSU プロセッソームの構成要素で、共免疫沈降と two-hyb: Utp25 is a component of the SSU processome and binds Mpp10 by co-immunoprecipitation and two-hybrid assays (20884785)
Utp30 と Nep1 は 90S 前駆体の形成で共に働く（遺伝学と生化学）。: Utp30 and Nep1 act together in formation of the 90S precursor (genetics and biochemistry). High expression of UTP30 partially restores growth of nep1-1(ts) (22588997)
Utp6 の HAT 領域が Utp21 の特定のペプチドに結合する（Kd 10: The HAT region of Utp6 binds a specific peptide of Utp21 (Kd 10 μM) (18725399)
Utp6 の N 末端領域が Utp18 と結合する（18725399）: The N-terminal region of Utp6 binds Utp18 (18725399)
Utp7 は Sli15 に結合して局在を制御し、後期の前に Sli15 が紡錘: Utp7 binds Sli15 and controls its localization, preventing premature accumulation of Sli15 on the spindle before anaphase (18794331)
Utp8 と Utp9 は直接結合し、その結合で Utp8 が U3 snoRN: Utp8 and Utp9 bind directly, and this binding attaches Utp8 to the U3 snoRNA and the SSU processome (20138832)
Utp9 は Msn5 による逆行 tRNA の核外再輸送を助け、Utp8・Gs: Utp9 assists Msn5-mediated nuclear re-export of retrograde-imported tRNA and binds Utp8, Gsp1, and Msn5 directly in vitro (19812255)
V-ATPase の活性が失われると Pma1 が補償的に細胞膜から取り込まれる: When V-ATPase activity is lost, Pma1 is compensatorily internalized from the plasma membrane. The calcium-responsive phosphatase (calcineurin) and the glucose-sensitive Glc7 show negative synthetic interactions with vma mutations, and both are essential for Pma1 ubiquitination and endocytic downregulation (29254995)
V1 の柄のサブユニット Vma7（F）と Vma8（D）の相互作用を示した（9: An interaction between the V1 stalk subunits Vma7 (F) and Vma8 (D) was shown (9334266)
VINE が Glc7 を呼び込み、BLOC-1 の Kxd1 の脱リン酸を導き: VINE recruits Glc7, directing dephosphorylation of the BLOC-1 subunit Kxd1 and strengthening Kxd1 binding to Msb3 (42412525)
VINE は GEF サブユニット Vrl1 のアンキリン反復ドメインを通じてホ: VINE recruits the phosphatase Glc7 through the ankyrin repeat domain of the GEF subunit Vrl1 (42412525)
VMA11 破壊株の液胞には subunit c（VMA3 産物）も subun: In vacuoles of VMA11 disruptants, neither subunit c (VMA3 product) nor subunits a and b are incorporated, and activity and vacuolar acidification are lost (1837023)
VPS9 ドメインをもつ Muk1 は Vps21・Ypt52・Ypt53 に対: The VPS9 domain-containing Muk1 acts as a second GEF for Vps21, Ypt52, and Ypt53. In vivo it partially overlaps with Vps9, and vps9Δ muk1Δ shows trafficking defects closely resembling multiple Rab5 deletions (23612966). Consistent with the GO direction (activation)
VTH1・VTH2 の過剰発現で vps10Δ の誤輸送が抑えられるが、VTH1: Overexpression of VTH1 or VTH2 suppresses missorting in vps10Δ, but disruption of VTH1 and VTH2 does not affect transport of proteinase A (Pep4) (8662642)
Vac14 がないと Fig4-GFP は液胞に局在しない。Fig4 は Vac: Without Vac14, Fig4-GFP does not localize to the vacuole. Fig4 physically binds Vac14 (14528018)
Vac8 のパルミトイル化は液胞の融合に必須。Pfa3 は体内で Vac8 の膜: Vac8 palmitoylation is essential for vacuole fusion. Pfa3 promotes membrane association and palmitoylation of Vac8 in vivo, and partially purified Pfa3 palmitoylates Vac8 in vitro. Without Pfa3, vacuoles fragment under stress (16186255). Vac8 palmitoylation is important for its functions such as vacuole fusion (19416974)
Vac8 は Atg13 と結合して Atg1 開始複合体を呼び寄せ、PAS を: Vac8 binds Atg13, recruiting the Atg1 initiation complex and tethering the PAS to the vacuolar membrane. Deletion or mislocalization of VAC8 reduces autophagic activity (32508216). Vac8 and Apg13 (Atg13) bind in two-hybrid and coprecipitation assays (10837477)
Var1 を欠く小サブユニットには Mrp2 が入らず、Var1 が Mrp2: Mrp2 is not incorporated into small subunits lacking Var1, so Var1 is important for Mrp2 incorporation (7770043)
Vhs2 は Cdc14 の新しい基質で、分裂直前に脱リン酸化されセプチンの構成: Vhs2 is a new Cdc14 substrate that is dephosphorylated just before division and is involved in septin organization (24646733)
Vhs2 は S 期から核分裂までリン酸化され、細胞分裂直前に脱リン酸化される。: Vhs2 is phosphorylated from S phase until nuclear division and dephosphorylated just before cell division. This is controlled by Cdk1 and Cdc14 (24646733)
Vhs3 は生体内で Ppz1 の C 末端の触媒部分に結合し、試験管内で Pp: Vhs3 binds the C-terminal catalytic region of Ppz1 in vivo and inhibits Ppz1 phosphatase activity in vitro. The vhs3 mutant and overexpression phenotypes resemble those of Hal3 and are opposite to Ppz1 (15192104)
Vik1 は Kar3 と結合し、栄養増殖期の Kar3 の紡錘体極への集積には: Vik1 binds Kar3, and accumulation of Kar3 at spindle poles during vegetative growth requires Vik1 (but not Cik1) (10087265)
Vma12/Vma22 複合体は Vph1 と直接・一過的に結合する（96608: The Vma12/Vma22 complex binds Vph1 directly and transiently (9660861)
Vma12（VPH2）と Vma22 は安定な膜結合の複合体をつくる（96608: Vma12 (VPH2) and Vma22 form a stable membrane-associated complex (9660861)
Vma3p を欠く細胞では HXK2 の発現が下がる（RT-PCR）（28899: HXK2 expression decreases in cells lacking Vma3p (RT-PCR) (28899778)
Vma5（C）と Vma10（G）はどちらも Vma4（E）と強く結合する。Vm: Vma5 (C) and Vma10 (G) both bind Vma4 (E) strongly. Mutations at the Vma4 N-terminus disrupt binding to Vma5 and abolish function in vivo (15751969)
Vma7（F）と Vma8（D）の相互作用を示した（9334266）: An interaction between Vma7 (F) and Vma8 (D) was shown (9334266)
Vms1 はミトコンドリア表面で 60S リボソームに結合して Rqc2 に逆ら: Vms1 binds 60S ribosomes at the mitochondrial surface, counteracts Rqc2, promotes import, and prevents aggregation (29107329)
Voa1 は Vma21 と V0 のプロテオリピドのリングに最も強く結合し、V: Voa1 binds Vma21 and the V0 proteolipid ring most strongly and dissociates after V0 assembly (18799613)
Vph1 のテザーを縮めると V0 の d サブユニットが組み込まれず、VMA6: Shortening the Vph1 tether prevents incorporation of the V0 d subunit, which is restored by adding VMA6 (19473972)
Vps1 の S599 は Pho85 に体内・試験管内でリン酸化され、S599: Vps1 S599 is phosphorylated by Pho85 in vivo and in vitro, and mutating S599 causes defects in scission of endocytic vesicles (26711254)
Vps2 は MIT ドメインで直接、Vps60 は Vta1 を介して Vps: Vps2 stimulates Vps4 ATPase activity directly via the MIT domain, and Vps60 does so via Vta1 (18194652)
Vps2 は Vps4 を直接、Vps60 は Vta1 を介して促し、Did2: Vps2 stimulates Vps4 directly and Vps60 via Vta1, while Did2 stimulates Vps4 ATPase activity by both mechanisms depending on the context (18194652)
Vps20 が Doa4 の N 末端に結合して、ILV 形成を促す Doa4: Vps20 binds the Doa4 N-terminus and inhibits a non-catalytic function of Doa4 that promotes ILV formation (23444383). Binding to Vps20 suppresses deubiquitination of ILV cargo (28057764)
Vps25 の 2 つの PPXY モチーフが Vps22・Vps36 と接し、: Two PPXY motifs of Vps25 contact Vps22 and Vps36, and their mutation disrupts ESCRT-II (15469844)
Vps28 の C 末端が Vps36 の NZF-N ドメインにナノモルの親和: The Vps28 C-terminus binds the NZF-N domain of Vps36 with nanomolar affinity, linking ESCRT-I and ESCRT-II (17215868)
Vps2–Vps24 の下位複合体が Vps20–Snf7 の複合体に結合する（: The Vps2–Vps24 subcomplex binds the Vps20–Snf7 complex (12194857)
Vps3 と Vps39 は Vps11 の C 末端の共通領域で Vps-C: Vps3 and Vps39 bind the Vps-C core via a shared C-terminal region of Vps11 (21325627)
Vps33 は Vam3・Vam7・Nyv1 の SNARE ドメインと、四者の: Vps33 binds directly to the SNARE domains of Vam3, Vam7, and Nyv1 and to the four-SNARE complex (23051737)
Vps5 と Vps17 は C 末端のコイルドコイルで結合し二量体を作る（12: Vps5 and Vps17 bind via their C-terminal coiled coils to form a dimer (12181349)
Vps501 の液胞膜への局在は Sea1 との直接の結合に依存する（35098: Localization of Vps501 to the vacuolar membrane depends on direct binding to Sea1 (35098628)
Vps51p が Vps52/53/54 と t-SNARE Tlg1p の結び: Vps51p mediates the association of Vps52/53/54 with the t-SNARE Tlg1p and binds the N-terminal domain of Tlg1p (12686613)
Vps52・Vps53・Vps54 は 1:1:1 の複合体として共免疫沈降し、: Vps52, Vps53, and Vps54 co-immunoprecipitate as a 1:1:1 complex required for sorting at the late Golgi (10637310)
Vps52・Vps53・Vps54 は 1:1:1 の複合体（10637310）: Vps52, Vps53, and Vps54 form a 1:1:1 complex (10637310)
Vps55 と Vps68 は複合体を作り、ESCRT と共に、あるいはその下流: Vps55 and Vps68 form a complex and regulate endosomal trafficking together with, or downstream of, ESCRT (18216282)
Vps74 のゴルジへの局在には Pik1 による PtdIns4P の合成が続: Golgi localization of Vps74 requires ongoing PtdIns4P synthesis by Pik1 (20026658)
Vps74 は Sac1 の触媒ドメインに直接結合（KD 3.8 μM）。vps: Vps74 binds the Sac1 catalytic domain directly (KD 3.8 μM). PtdIns4P in the medial Golgi increases in vps74Δ and sac1Δ (22553352)
Vrg4（GMT）の細胞質側の C 末端ペプチドが COPI の Ret2 に結: The cytoplasmic C-terminal peptide of Vrg4 (GMT) binds the COPI subunit Ret2, and GMT mutants with weak binding are transported to the vacuole (15494368)
Vrp1 は Las17 結合ドメインで Las17 に結合して、または N 末: Vrp1 localizes to cortical patches either by binding Las17 via its Las17-binding domain or independently of Las17 via its N-terminal region. Binding is essential for actin patch polarization at high temperature (20816901)
Vtc2 は SPX-SPX の相互作用で触媒サブユニット Vtc4 を抑える。: Vtc2 inhibits the catalytic subunit Vtc4 via SPX-SPX interactions. Inositol pyrophosphate binding relieves this and activates VTC (37156835)
Vts1 は Ccr4-Pop2-Not による脱アデニル化を介して mRNA: Vts1 promotes mRNA decay via Ccr4-Pop2-Not-mediated deadenylation and binds this complex (18469165)
W303 由来で Ybp1 に終止変異がある株では、Gpx3 ではなく Tsa1: In W303-derived strains carrying a nonsense mutation in Ybp1, Tsa1 rather than Gpx3 is required for Yap1 activation (15706081). Tsa1 forms a disulfide bond with Yap1 and drives formation of the Yap1 intramolecular disulfide bond (active form) (19106090). Confidence is medium because this is limited to certain strains
WEE1 は H2B Tyr37 をリン酸化する酵素で、その発現を失うか阻害する: WEE1 is the enzyme that phosphorylates H2B Tyr37; loss or inhibition of its expression abolishes this H2B phosphorylation in both yeast and mammalian cells and increases histone gene transcription. In yeast, H2B (Y40) is not phosphorylated in swe1Δ (22885324)

WTM2 の高発現で DNA 損傷なしに RNR3-lacZ が上がり、Wtm2: High expression of WTM2 raises RNR3-lacZ without DNA damage, and Wtm2 binds the RNR3 promoter (apparently directly). It amplifies RNR3 induction under replication stress (16980392)
WWM1 の過剰発現は増殖停止とクローン死を起こし、MCA1 の同時の過剰発現で: WWM1 overexpression causes growth arrest and clonal death, which is suppressed by simultaneous overexpression of MCA1 (12062425)
War1 が PDR12 の転写誘導を担い、WARE に試験管内・生体内で結合す: War1 mediates transcriptional induction of PDR12 and binds the WARE in vitro and in vivo. Deletion strains cannot induce Pdr12 with sorbic acid (12588995)
Whi2 は低アミノ酸に応じて TORC1 の活性と増殖を抑えるのに必要な負の調: Whi2 is a negative regulator required to inhibit TORC1 activity and growth in response to low amino acids, but is not required under low glucose (30142151). The Whi2-Psr1-Psr2 complex inhibits TORC1 under low leucine but not in the absence of a nitrogen source (40103213)
Whi3 は CLN3 の mRNA に特異的に結合して細胞質の点に集め、Cln: Whi3 specifically binds CLN3 mRNA and concentrates it in cytoplasmic foci, negatively regulating Cln3 (11691832). Whi3 binds Cdc28, and in whi3 mutants Cln3 and Cdc28 accumulate in the nucleus from early G1 (14685274). whi3 mutations increase CLN3 mRNA half-life, levels, and translation efficiency, which can explain the small cell size (24386402)
Whi3 は PKA にリン酸化され、S568 のリン酸化は Whi3 の働きを: Whi3 is phosphorylated by PKA, and S568 phosphorylation inhibits Whi3 function. Phosphorylation reduces binding of Whi3 to the mRNA of the G1 cyclin CLN3 and is required for progression into G1/S. Yku80-Dnl4 と Xrs2-Lif1 の結合を両方壊すと NHEJ と: Disrupting both Yku80-Dnl4 and Xrs2-Lif1 binding abolishes NHEJ and recruitment of ligase IV to DSBs (18832348). Nej1 and Dnl4-Lif1 are recruited to DSBs independently by yKu (21149442)
Ylr266c（PDR8）の活性型で上がる遺伝子のうち直接の標的を ChIP で: Among genes upregulated by the active form of Ylr266c (PDR8), direct targets were identified by ChIP. YLL056c is one of them (12529331)
Yme1 のアダプター Mgr1 と Mgr3 は外膜タンパク質の膜間腔ドメイン: The Yme1 adaptors Mgr1 and Mgr3 recognize the intermembrane-space domains of outer membrane proteins and recruit them for degradation by Yme1 (29138251)
Yml081w（Aaf1）は ALD6 の転写を、上流 590 bp の GAG: Yml081w (Aaf1) increases ALD6 transcription via a GAGGGG sequence 590 bp upstream (23240040)
Yng1 は NuA3 の安定な構成要素で、Sas3 とヌクレオソームの相互作用: Yng1 is a stable component of NuA3 that mediates the interaction between Sas3 and nucleosomes and is required for NuA3 to modify histone tails (12077334)
Yop1（と Rtn1）は Ndc1 や NPC の膜タンパク質と物理的に結合す: Yop1 (and Rtn1) physically bind Ndc1 and NPC membrane proteins. The SPB and NPC defects of rtn1Δ yop1Δ are rescued by NDC1 overexpression (22798490)
Yos1 は Yip1・Yif1 と会合し、Yip1-Yif1 複合体のサブユニ: Yos1 associates with Yip1 and Yif1 and is a subunit of the Yip1-Yif1 complex (15659647)
Yos9 は Hrd3 と結合し、ER の品質管理を HRD リガーゼにつなぐ（: Yos9 binds Hrd3, linking ER quality control to the HRD ligase (16845381)
Ypa1（Rrd1）は Pph3・Sit4・Ppg1 と特異的に直接結合し、不活: Ypa1 (Rrd1) specifically and directly binds Pph3, Sit4, and Ppg1 and reactivates inactive PP2A-like complexes (15447631)
Ypd1 のリン酸が Ssk1 の Asp554 に渡る。通常時はこのリン酸化で: Phosphate from Ypd1 is transferred to Asp554 of Ssk1. Under normal conditions, this phosphorylation keeps Ssk1 from activating the HOG pathway
Ypi1 は Glc7・Sds22 と複合体をつくり、等量の Ypi1 と Sd: Ypi1 forms a complex with Glc7 and Sds22, and equimolar Ypi1 and Sds22 almost completely inhibit Glc7 activity (17142459). Ypi1 and Sds22 are positive regulators of nuclear Glc7 activity (18172024)
Ypi1 は Glc7・Sds22 と複合体を作り、Ypi1 を減らすと Glc: Ypi1 forms a complex with Glc7 and Sds22, and depleting Ypi1 alters the nuclear localization of Glc7 and causes arrest partway through mitosis (17142459)
Ypi1 を枯渇させると核の PP1 が減り、核の Sds22 が失われる（18: Depleting Ypi1 reduces nuclear PP1 and causes loss of nuclear Sds22 (18172024)
Ypk1 が熱ストレスの信号を Orm のリン酸化として伝え、熱で誘導されたスフ: Ypk1 transmits heat stress signals as Orm phosphorylation, and heat-induced sphingolipid synthesis causes Orm dephosphorylation, making the induction transient. Cdc55-PP2A is the main phosphatase counteracting Ypk1 (22535525)
Ypk1 の新しい基質としてセラミド合成酵素の 2 つの触媒サブユニット（Lag: The two catalytic subunits of ceramide synthase (Lag1, Lac1) were found as new Ypk1 substrates. Phosphorylation by Ypk1 increases with sphingolipid depletion and heat shock and is important for survival. Phosphorylation raises specific activity and channels long-chain bases into complex sphingolipids (25279700)
Ypk1 は Orm1・Orm2 を in vitro で直接リン酸化し、リン酸: Ypk1 directly phosphorylates Orm1 and Orm2 in vitro, and phosphorylation inactivates the Orm proteins
Ypk1 は Rom2 を細胞膜に正しく局在させることで Pkc1 の活性を調節: Ypk1 regulates Pkc1 activity by properly localizing Rom2 to the plasma membrane, which also depends on Fpk1 and sphingolipids (25253719)
Ypk1/2 を阻害すると、カルシニューリンが制御するストレス応答遺伝子の発現が: Inhibiting Ypk1/2 increases expression of calcineurin-controlled stress response genes. Ypk1/2 negatively regulate calcineurin (22307609)
Ypp1 は Stt4 と結合して安定性を調節し、Stt4 の PIK パッチへ: Ypp1 binds Stt4 and regulates its stability, and is required for assembly and recruitment of Stt4 to PIK patches (19075114)
Ypt/Sec4 は II 型ゲラニルゲラニル転移酵素（GGTase-II）によ: Ypt/Sec4 proteins associate with membranes through modification by type II geranylgeranyltransferase (GGTase-II). Mutations in the catalytic subunit Bet2 disrupt membrane association of Ypt1 and Sec4 and block membrane traffic. Mrs6 is component A and is required for membrane association of Ypt1 and Sec4 (8183917)
Ypt1 は Atg23・Atg17 に結合し、Ypt1-Atg17 の結合は: Ypt1 binds Atg23 and Atg17, and Ypt1-Atg17 binding contributes to recruitment of Ypt1 and Atg1 to the PAS. Phosphomimetic Ypt1 S174D impairs recruitment of Atg1 to the PAS and its activation (37635626)
Ypt1 は Atg23・Atg17 に結合する。Ypt1-Atg23 の結合を: Ypt1 binds Atg23 and Atg17. Disrupting Ypt1-Atg23 binding reduces binding of Atg9 to Atg11, Atg13, and Atg17, and Atg9 vesicles fail to gather at the PAS (37635626)
Ypt1 は TOR により S174 でリン酸化される。S174A は TOR: Ypt1 is phosphorylated by TOR at S174. S174A abolishes TOR phosphorylation and enhances autophagy, whereas phosphomimetic S174D impairs recruitment of Ypt1 and Atg1 to the PAS and Atg1 activation, inhibiting autophagy (37635626)
Ypt1 は Yip3 と共精製される。Rtn1 も Yip3 と結合するが Y: Ypt1 copurifies with Yip3. Rtn1 also binds Yip3 but in a complex separate from Ypt1. Rab localization is unchanged in yip3Δ (16002643)
Ypt11 は Myo2 の尾部と複合体を作り、ミトコンドリアの芽への分配で M: Ypt11 forms a complex with the Myo2 tail and promotes Myo2 function in mitochondrial inheritance into the bud (12391144)
Ypt11 はコートマーの Ret2 に結合し、Myo2 と後期 Golgi を: Ypt11 binds the coatomer subunit Ret2, linking Myo2 to the late Golgi (18595704)
Ypt31/32 が Sec2 の働きを調節する証拠（YPT31/YPT32 に: Evidence that Ypt31/32 regulate Sec2 function is presented (suppression of sec2-78 by YPT31/YPT32, restoration of localization by overexpression, and binding to Ypt32) (12045183)
Ypt31/32 の過剰発現が sec2-78 の局在を戻し、Ypt32 と S: Overexpression of Ypt31/32 restores sec2-78 localization, and Ypt32 and Sec2 bind biochemically (12045183). Unphosphorylated Sec2 binds Ypt32-GTP, leading to Sec4 activation (24248333). Sec2 is recruited to secretory vesicles by Ypt32 and PI4P (26700316)
Ypt31/32 は Sec7 の交換活性を強く促す（25220393）。本文:: Ypt31/32 strongly stimulate Sec7 exchange activity (25220393). Main text: stimulation depends on the GTP-bound form and is reduced by the ypt31-101 mutation. Cargo sorting is disrupted in ypt31/32 mutants
Ypt6 は一時的にゴルジにいて、Ypt32 が来ると細胞質へ離れる。Gyp6: Ypt6 resides transiently at the Golgi and dissociates into the cytoplasm when Ypt32 arrives. Gyp6 binds Ypt32 specifically, and with GYP6 disruption or GAP-dead mutants, Ypt6 persists at the Golgi (24194547). GYP6 encodes a GAP with high specificity for Ypt6 (8441469)
Ypt7 の活性化が Vps21 の不活性化を引き起こす Rab カスケード。M: A Rab cascade in which Ypt7 activation causes Vps21 inactivation. Overexpression of Mon1-Ccz1 or active Ypt7 relocates Vps21 to the ER, which is prevented by loss of BLOC-1 or Msb3 (25971802)
Yra1 は Dbp2 の一本鎖 RNA への結合を妨げ、濃度に応じて二本鎖をほ: Yra1 prevents Dbp2 binding to single-stranded RNA and concentration-dependently inhibits its duplex-unwinding activity (26876600). Yra1 lowers the unwinding efficiency of Dbp2 (23721653)
Yrb1 の核外輸送には RBD が要り、RBD は RanGTP 存在下で X: Nuclear export of Yrb1 requires its RBD, which forms a ternary complex with Xpo1 (Crm1) in the presence of RanGTP (10825193)
Yrb1 は核と細胞質を行き来し、CRM1(XPO1) 依存の経路で核外へ運ばれ: Yrb1 shuttles between the nucleus and cytoplasm and is exported via a CRM1 (XPO1)-dependent pathway (10825193)
Yrb2 は Crm1 に直接結合し、yrb2 欠損で NES に依存する核外輸: Yrb2 binds Crm1 directly; yrb2 mutants show delayed NES-dependent nuclear export, which is suppressed by an extra copy of XPO1/CRM1 (10050047). Yrb2 greatly accelerates binding of Gsp1-GTP and NES to Crm1 (structural and in vitro, 25437554)
Yrb30 は Yrb1 と競合して GTP 型の Gsp1 に結合し、RanG: Yrb30 competes with Yrb1 to bind GTP-bound Gsp1 and forms a ternary complex with RanGTP and karyopherins (12578832)
Yrb30 は Yrb1 と違い、Rna1 による Ran の GTP 加水分解: Unlike Yrb1, Yrb30 inhibits Rna1-stimulated GTP hydrolysis by Ran (12578832)
Yrr1 は YOR1 の活性化を通してオリゴマイシン耐性をもたらし、ChIP: Yrr1 confers oligomycin resistance through activation of YOR1 and binds target promoters by ChIP (11134057). YOR1 is a direct target of Yrr1 (11909958)
Ysh1 のユビキチン化は Ubc4 と RING ユビキチンリガーゼの Mpe: Ysh1 ubiquitination is mediated by Ubc4 and the RING ubiquitin ligase Mpe1, and Ysh1 is degraded by the proteasome (32009536)
Ysp2 とその相同遺伝子 Lam4/Ltc3 は体内で Ypk1 の基質で、Y: Ysp2 and its homologs Lam4/Ltc3 are Ypk1 substrates in vivo, and Ypk1 phosphorylation inhibits their function in promoting retrograde sterol transport from the plasma membrane to the ER. In the full text, the Lam4 sites are S401 and S667 (29927351, 33255682)
Ysp2（Lam2）は生体内の Ypk1 の基質で、リン酸化は細胞膜から ER: Ysp2 (Lam2) is an in vivo Ypk1 substrate, and phosphorylation inhibits retrograde sterol transport from the plasma membrane to the ER (29927351). Phosphorylation prevents Lam2 binding to Laf1 (33255682)
Ysw1 は two-hybrid で Gip1 と結合し、この結合が gip1: Ysw1 binds Gip1 in two-hybrid assays, and this binding is required for suppression of gip1 mutations (19465564)
Ytm1 と Erb1 はβプロペラ同士で結合し、結合面の変異は 60S の成熟: Ytm1 and Erb1 bind via their β-propellers, and interface mutations block 60S maturation (26657628)
Ytm1・Erb1・Nop7 は互いに依存して前リボソームに組み込まれ、互いの相: Ytm1, Erb1, and Nop7 are incorporated into pre-ribosomes interdependently, and the domains required for their mutual interactions were identified (18448671)
Yvc1 の脱グルタチオン化は Trx2 による（27708136）: Deglutathionylation of Yvc1 is mediated by Trx2 (27708136)
Yvh1 による Mrt4 の解離が、細胞質での pre-60S への Rpp0: Release of Mrt4 by Yvh1 is an essential step preceding loading of Rpp0 onto pre-60S in the cytoplasm (19797079)
Yvh1 は pre-60S から Mrt4 を放出させるのに必要。yvh1 欠: Yvh1 is required to release Mrt4 from pre-60S. In yvh1 deletion, Mrt4 remains on cytoplasmic pre-60S (19797078). Yvh1 triggers Mrt4 release in the nucleus (27775710)
ZRC1 の転写は亜鉛の制限で、亜鉛に応答する転写因子 Zap1 によって誘導さ: ZRC1 transcription is induced under zinc limitation by the zinc-responsive transcription factor Zap1 (12556516). ZRC1 expression is induced in a Zap1-dependent manner when intracellular zinc decreases, and is repressed by zinc (11027563)
ZRG8 は ram 欠失の致死の多コピー抑圧因子。Zrg8 は Ssd1 と共: ZRG8 is a multicopy suppressor of the lethality of ram deletions. Zrg8 coprecipitates with Ssd1 and is thought to be a nonessential inhibitor of Ssd1 (15972461)
ZRT2 は低亜鉛で抑えられ亜鉛を補うと誘導される。Zap1 の低親和性 ZRE: ZRT2 is repressed under low zinc and induced upon zinc supplementation. A low-affinity Zap1 ZRE (repression) and a high-affinity ZRE (activation) antagonize each other (14976557)
ZWF1 を欠くとストレスの有無に関わらず Yap1 が活性化し、その標的 Ct: Loss of ZWF1 activates Yap1 regardless of stress and increases its target Ctt1. Loss of yap1 or ctt1 abolishes the stress tolerance of zwf1Δ (33648021)
Zap1 依存の活性化で RTC4 mRNA は増えるが Rtc4 タンパク質は: Zap1-dependent activation increases RTC4 mRNA but decreases Rtc4 protein. An upstream ORF in the long 5′ leader blocks translation (28971534)
Zds1 と Zds2 はセパレースの下流で核小体からの Cdc14 の放出を助: Zds1 and Zds2 assist release of Cdc14 from the nucleolus downstream of separase, activating Cdc14 at anaphase onset. Ectopic expression of Zds1 lowers PP2A-Cdc55 and promotes Net1 phosphorylation (18762578)
Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) は Rho1 の GAP Lrg1: Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) inhibits the Rho1 GAP Lrg1 to promote polarized growth and cell wall synthesis. In the main text, Lrg1 levels are unchanged in cdc55Δ, but Lrg1 bound to active Rho1 increases and total cellular Lrg1 GAP activity rises. The glucan synthesis defect of cdc55Δ is due to excessive Lrg1 activity
Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) は Rho1 の GAP Sac7: Zds1/Zds2-PP2A(Cdc55) stabilizes the Rho1 GAP Sac7, inhibiting the cell wall pathway. In the main text, Sac7 protein decreases in cdc55Δ (not transcriptionally) and is restored by proteasome mutations
Zip1 の S75 は Mec1 のコンセンサス部位で、mec1 変異体ではセ: Zip1 S75 is a Mec1 consensus site, and centromere pairing is restored in mec1 mutants. Persistent S75 phosphorylation causes loss of centromere pairing but does not change synapsis or DSB repair (20951350). In early meiosis, Mec1/Tel1 is activated, phosphorylates Zip1, and destabilizes homology-independent centromere pairing (23775120)
Zip2・Zip4・Spo16 は互いに結合し DNA 結合複合体をつくる。Zi: Zip2, Zip4, and Spo16 bind each other and form a DNA-binding complex. Zip2:Spo16 is a heterodimer resembling XPF:ERCC1 (30566683)
Zip3 は SUMO の E3 リガーゼで、Zip1 は SUMO 結合体に結: Zip3 is a SUMO E3 ligase, and Zip1 binds SUMO conjugates. From mid-prophase on, Zip1 binds Zip3-dependent Smt3 conjugates (such as Red1) to form the SC (16847351)
Znf1 は細胞壁合成の FKS1・SED1・SMI1 などを活性化する（341: Znf1 activates cell wall synthesis genes such as FKS1, SED1, and SMI1 (34105981)
Zpr1 は eEF1A の生合成専用のシャペロンで、折りたたみに GTP 加水: Zpr1 is a dedicated chaperone for eEF1A biogenesis, and folding requires GTP hydrolysis (37597513)
Zrt3*-GFP の分解には Tul1 と Rsp5 の両方が寄与する（本文、: Both Tul1 and Rsp5 contribute to degradation of Zrt3*-GFP (main text, 26527740)
Zta1p の欠失でアミノ酸合成の遺伝子群の発現が下がり、Zta1p は ARG: Zta1p deletion lowers expression of amino acid biosynthesis genes, and Zta1p extends the half-life of ARG4 mRNA, controlling expression post-transcriptionally (25715111)
Zuo1 の C 末端と Ssz1 の N 末端はそれぞれ単独で Pdr1 を活: The Zuo1 C-terminus and the Ssz1 N-terminus can each activate Pdr1 on their own (22203981). The C-terminal 13 residues of Zuo1 appear to bind Pdr1 directly, resembling xenobiotic activation of Pdr1 (23036859)
a 細胞特異的遺伝子は MATα 細胞で α2/Mcm1 により抑えられる。BA: a-specific genes are repressed in MATα cells by α2/Mcm1. Examining BAR1 showed that nucleosome positioning is required for full repression (16980406)
ack1 欠失株は CWI レポーター活性が低く、エピスタシスで Ack1 は: ack1 deletion strains have low CWI reporter activity; by epistasis, Ack1 acts upstream of Pkc1 and depends on Rom2 and Tus1 (18806213)
adk1 欠損で PHO・ADE 遺伝子が強く誘導される。PHO84 の上昇には: Loss of adk1 strongly induces PHO and ADE genes. The increase in PHO84 requires Spl2 (18433446)
adr1Δ で PEX11 の転写の上昇が無くなり、Pex11 の量も大きく減る: In adr1Δ, the increase in PEX11 transcription is lost and Pex11 levels are greatly reduced. The PEX11 promoter contains a UAS1-like sequence overlapping the ORE (11431484)
ady1（pfs1）変異株では減数分裂特異的な SPB 構成要素 Mpc54 が: In ady1 (pfs1) mutants, the meiosis-specific SPB component Mpc54 localizes to only one or two spindle poles per cell (11553705)
aer2（tup1）変異で CYC7 の発現がすべての条件で大きく上がる。AER: aer2 (tup1) mutations greatly increase CYC7 expression under all conditions. AER2 is the same gene as TUP1 (1900249)
aim23 欠失で Atp9 の合成速度が上がる（26728900）: aim23 deletion increases the rate of Atp9 synthesis (26728900)
aim23 欠失で Cox1・Cox2・Cox3 の発現が抑えられ、Atp9 の: aim23 deletion suppresses expression of Cox1, Cox2, and Cox3 and increases the rate of Atp9 synthesis (26728900)
akr1 欠失で Ste3 の半減期が 5 倍以上に延び、受容体の合成を止めても: akr1 deletion extends the half-life of Ste3 more than 5-fold, allowing mating to continue long after receptor synthesis is stopped (9243510). Akr1 appears to function in localizing Yck1/Yck2 to the plasma membrane (10866691)
alg12Δ でたまる Man7GlcNAc2 は ALG9 がコードする α1: The Man7GlcNAc2 that accumulates in alg12Δ was confirmed to be the product of the α1,2-mannosyltransferase encoded by ALG9 (12460943)
alg5-1 は Dol-P-Glc を作れず、alg6-1 は Dol-P-G: alg5-1 cannot make Dol-P-Glc, and alg6-1 cannot transfer glucose from Dol-P-Glc to the lipid-linked oligosaccharide. Experiments with microsomes were also performed (6423630)
alk1Δ では Mih1 の早すぎる活性化で Cdc28-Y19 のリン酸化が: In alk1Δ, premature activation of Mih1 reduces Cdc28-Y19 phosphorylation, and cells enter mitosis even without a bud (33585466)
aly1Δ でも Dip5 のエンドサイトーシスが損なわれるが aly2Δ ほど: Dip5 endocytosis is also impaired in aly1Δ, but less than in aly2Δ (20956561). Calcineurin-mediated dephosphorylation of Aly1 is required for Aly1-mediated transport of Dip5 to the vacuole (23824189)
aly2Δ では Dip5 が細胞膜で安定になりエンドサイトーシスされない。Di: In aly2Δ, Dip5 is stable at the plasma membrane and is not endocytosed. Efficient ubiquitination of Dip5 depends on Aly2. Aly2 is an adaptor linking Rsp5 and Dip5 (20956561)
ama1Δ は前胞子膜の閉鎖に欠陥があり、前胞子膜の先端の Ssp1 が ama: ama1Δ is defective in prospore membrane closure, and Ssp1 at the leading edge of the prospore membrane is stabilized in ama1Δ. Inactivating Ssp1 with a conditional mutation partially restores the sporulation defect of ama1Δ, so the essential function of Ama1 is to remove Ssp1 (18946082)
aps1Δ は chc1-ts の生育遅延・α因子成熟の欠陥を強め、Chc を完: aps1Δ enhances the slow growth and α-factor maturation defects of chc1-ts and also enhances the growth defect of cells completely lacking Chc (8157009)
arc19 欠失細胞では Arp2p・Arp3p・Arc40p が単量体の画分に: In arc19 deletion cells, Arp2p, Arp3p, and Arc40p shift to the monomeric fraction; Arc19p is the central scaffold of the complex (10377407)
art3Δ 細胞は Put4 のエンドサイトーシスに欠陥があり、Art3 が P: art3Δ cells are defective in Put4 endocytosis, and Art3 is a key regulator of Put4 endocytosis (32800549)
atp25 変異で ATP9 mRNA と Atp9p が減り、Atp25p は: atp25 mutations reduce ATP9 mRNA and Atp9p, and Atp25p is required for ATP9 mRNA stability (18216280)
avl9Δ でエンドソームの積み荷 Snc1 のリサイクルが損なわれる（4245: Recycling of the endosomal cargo Snc1 is impaired in avl9Δ (42459062, J Cell Sci)
bcy1 変異はアデニル酸シクラーゼ欠損の致死を抑圧する。BCY1 は cAMP: bcy1 mutations suppress the lethality of adenylate cyclase deficiency. BCY1 is the regulatory subunit of cAMP-dependent kinase (cAMP releases BCY1)
bcy1Δ では Ras2 Val19 と同じく、エタノールへ移しても Hxt3: In bcy1Δ, as with Ras2 Val19, Hxt3 internalization and degradation do not occur even after a shift to ethanol (23227176)
bcy1（PKA が常に働く）では GS-2（GSY2）の mRNA とタンパク: In bcy1 (constitutively active PKA), GS-2 (GSY2) mRNA and protein are greatly reduced. The cAMP pathway regulates both expression and phosphorylation of GS-2 (7961723)
bem1 欠失はフェロモンでの G1 停止と転写活性化に欠陥がある。Bem1 は: bem1 deletion is defective in pheromone-induced G1 arrest and transcriptional activation. Bem1 increases Fus3 activity and binds Ste5 (together with Ste11, Ste7, and Fus3) (8754808)
bi3 の ORF が作るタンパク質はシトクロム b の mRNA のスプライシ: The protein made from the bi3 ORF is a specific maturase acting in splicing of cytochrome b mRNA (2538624)
bir1-17 細胞では Ipl1 が一部局在を失い、キナーゼ活性が大きく下がる: In bir1-17 cells, Ipl1 partially loses its localization and its kinase activity is greatly reduced (19528231)
blm10Δ では Dnm1 の分解が試験管内でも生体内でも損なわれ、酸化ストレ: In blm10Δ, Dnm1 degradation is impaired both in vitro and in vivo, and mitochondrial fragmentation increases under oxidative stress (24604417)
bmh 変異株のプロテオームで Gpm1 などの糖新生の酵素の量が増え、多くは転: In the proteome of bmh mutants, levels of gluconeogenic enzymes such as Gpm1 increase, mostly without changes at the transcriptional level (17397208)
bni1Δ の背景で NPF の働きを欠く bud6 変異を調べ、Bud6 が体: Examining bud6 mutants lacking NPF function in a bni1Δ background shows that Bud6 promotes Bnr1 activity in vivo. Bud6 binds Bnr1 directly, but its NPF effect is masked by a short regulatory sequence and revealed by Bil1 binding (23671312). Bud6 strongly relieves Hof1-mediated inhibition of Bnr1 in vitro (30076201)
bni4 欠失でキチン沈着が非局在化し、Chs3 は bni4・chs4・セプチ: bni4 deletion delocalizes chitin deposition, and Chs3 is mislocalized in bni4, chs4, and septin mutants (9314530). Bni4 mutants that can bind the bud neck but not Glc7 cannot deliver CSIII to the bud neck (18480405)
bsd2 欠失株では Smf1 が液胞に入らず安定化する。マンガンの添加だけで: In bsd2 deletion strains, Smf1 does not enter the vacuole and is stabilized. Manganese addition alone triggers rapid Bsd2-dependent Smf1 degradation (9988727). Smf1 degradation requires Bsd2, which recruits Rsp5 (16456538)
bud27Δ で RPC128 の転写と RPC160 の翻訳が下がり、Pol: bud27Δ reduces RPC128 transcription and RPC160 translation and impairs Pol III assembly (26423792)
bul1Δ bul2Δ の二重変異で Tat2 の定常量が大きく増える（Tat1: The bul1Δ bul2Δ double mutant greatly increases steady-state Tat2 levels (Tat1 does not increase) (14560004)
cAMP-PKA と CK2 による Sir2 S473 のリン酸化が、Sir2: Phosphorylation of Sir2 S473 by cAMP-PKA and CK2 inhibits Sir2's functions in repressing transcription of PMA1 and others and in extending lifespan
cal1-1（CDC43 変異）では Rho1 の修飾が減り、膜の 1,3-β-: In cal1-1 (a CDC43 mutation), Rho1 modification decreases and membrane 1,3-β-glucan synthase activity falls. Unmodified Rho1 cannot bind Fks1, and only modified GST-Rho1 restores the activity of rho1-3 membranes (10608882). cal1-1 has increased soluble Rho1 at the restrictive temperature and is best suppressed by Rho1 overproduction (8804398)
cat8 変異で ADH2-lacZ の脱抑制は野生型の約 12% に下がる。C: In cat8 mutants, derepression of ADH2-lacZ drops to about 12% of wild type. Cat8 binds CSRE(ADH2) directly (gel shift) (11495982)
cbc2-NΔ42 の二倍体で胞子形成中に MER3・SAE3 のスプライシング: In cbc2-NΔ42 diploids, splicing of MER3 and SAE3 is specifically defective during sporulation, and intronless MER3 restores it (23002122)
cbk1 の凝集表現型の抑圧変異が CRM1 と ACE2 にあり、Ace2-C: Suppressor mutations of the cbk1 clumping phenotype lie in CRM1 and ACE2; they disrupt Ace2-Crm1 binding and block export, so Ace2 accumulates in both mother and daughter nuclei (18076379). Phosphorylation of two sites by Cbk1 prevents Ace2 binding to the nuclear export machinery (18715118)
cbk1・bck2 変異で熱ショック・細胞壁ストレス時の Mpk1 の活性化と: cbk1 and bck2 mutations abolish Mpk1 activation and Mpk1-dependent expression during heat shock and cell wall stress (phosphorylation is retained) (22031291)
ccc2 変異株は呼吸と鉄の取り込みに欠陥があり、Fet3 の細胞外側ドメインの: ccc2 mutants are defective in respiration and iron uptake and lack the copper-dependent oxidase activity of the Fet3 extracellular domain. Copper addition restores it (7708696)
cdc37 変異株では調べたキナーゼ 65 種のうち 51 種が減り、Cdc37: In cdc37 mutants, 51 of the 65 kinases examined are reduced; Cdc37 protects nascent kinases from degradation and then folds them together with Hsp90 (17242065). Main text: Tpk2 and Rim11 obtained from cdc37S14A have reduced activity
cdc37-1 では Cak1 の量と活性が大きく下がり、Cdc37 がないと翻: In cdc37-1, Cak1 levels and activity are greatly reduced, and without Cdc37, Cak1 is unstable during translation (10629030)
cdc37-1 では Cdc28 の量が少なく Thr169 がリン酸化されずサ: In cdc37-1, Cdc28 levels are low, Thr169 is not phosphorylated, and it does not bind cyclins. Pulse-chase shows that without Cdc37 function during translation, Cdc28 and Cak1 are unstable (10629030). In cdc37-1, binding of Cln2 and Clb2 to Cdc28 and its activation are impaired (7753858). Previously this was put on hold based only on a background sentence in 36594787, but it was decided based on the primary paper 10629030
cdc37-S14A では Slt2 の量が減り、細胞壁ストレスでの Slt2: In cdc37-S14A, Slt2 levels decrease and Slt2-dependent responses to cell wall stress (Rlm1 activation) are impaired. Slt2 forms a complex with Cdc37 in vivo (17220467)
cdc42 変異体では exocyst の極性のある局在が失われ分泌が無秩序にな: In cdc42 mutants, polarized localization of the exocyst is lost and secretion becomes disorganized. Sec3 binds GTP-bound Cdc42 directly (11595741). Disrupting both Sec3 binding to Cdc42 and to phospholipids blocks exocytosis and disrupts exocyst polarity (18195105)
cdh1Δ では Ase1 と Clb2 の分解が損なわれる（Pds1 は損なわ: In cdh1Δ, degradation of Ase1 and Clb2 is impaired (Pds1 is not) (9334304)
cds1 欠失株で PGS1 プロモーター-lacZ の発現が上がる。CDP-D: PGS1 promoter-lacZ expression increases in cds1 deletion strains. CDP-DAG synthesis capacity affects its expression (9565583)
cha4-1 変異でセリン・トレオニンによる CHA1 の誘導が起きない。Cha: In the cha4-1 mutant, serine and threonine fail to induce CHA1. Cha4 is a positive regulator that binds UASCHA (8889513)
chs6 変異では Chs3 がキトソームに溜まり、Chs6 は Chs3 をキ: In chs6 mutants, Chs3 accumulates in chitosomes, and Chs6 is required to transport Chs3 from chitosomes to the plasma membrane (9614194). The Chs5/6 complex transiently binds the cargo Chs3, and in chs5Δ and chs6Δ, Chs3 bound to the complex is greatly reduced (16855022)
cic1 変異で F-box の Cdc4・Grr1 が安定化し、Cic1 は試: cic1 mutations stabilize the F-box proteins Cdc4 and Grr1, and Cic1 binds Cdc4 in vitro and in vivo (11500370)
cmc2 欠失でミトコンドリアの Sod1 活性が 2 倍、CMC2 過剰発現で: cmc2 deletion doubles mitochondrial Sod1 activity, and CMC2 overexpression reduces it to 60% (20220131)
cmk2 欠失でカルシウム/カルシニューリンのシグナルが強まり、PMR1・PMC: cmk2 deletion enhances calcium/calcineurin signaling and increases PMR1 and PMC1 expression in a Crz1-dependent manner (30665402)
coa4Δ で減る Cox1 の量・COX の組み立て・呼吸が Cox11 の過: The reduced Cox1 levels, COX assembly, and respiration in coa4Δ are restored by Cox11 overexpression. Coa4 is placed in the copper delivery pathway to Cox1 (35666203)
coa6 と sco2 の二重欠失で Cox2 の生合成が完全に失われ、Coa6: The coa6 sco2 double deletion completely abolishes Cox2 biogenesis, and Coa6 interacts with Sco proteins (26669719)
cof1-8 細胞では細胞壁タンパク質 Bgl2 の分泌が遅れ、後期ゴルジにとど: In cof1-8 cells, secretion of the cell wall protein Bgl2 is delayed and it is retained in the late Golgi (22553351)
cog3-202 温度感受性株で Och1・Mnn1 の局在が乱れる（15229: Localization of Och1 and Mnn1 is disrupted in the temperature-sensitive cog3-202 strain (15229219)
coq4 点変異では Coq3p と Coq4 が高分子量の複合体として一緒に泳: In coq4 point mutants, Coq3p and Coq4 no longer comigrate as a high-molecular-weight complex. Coq4p organizes the Coq complex (19022396)
coq4-1 変異ミトコンドリアでは Coq3p・Coq4p・Coq7p のゲル: In coq4-1 mutant mitochondria, the gel filtration migration of Coq3p, Coq4p, and Coq7p is disrupted (19022396)
cox23 欠失の呼吸欠損は高い銅と COX17 多コピーで回復。Cox17 は: The respiratory defect of cox23 deletion is rescued by high copper and multicopy COX17. Cox17 acts downstream of Cox23 (15145942)
cox24 欠失では COX1 のイントロン aI2・aI3 の除去が止まる（1: In cox24 deletion, excision of the COX1 introns aI2 and aI3 is blocked (16339141)
cox7 欠失株では COX1 の産物（サブユニット I）の蓄積が減る（1658: In cox7 deletion strains, accumulation of the COX1 product (subunit I) is reduced (1658541)
cpr1 欠失で Zpr1 が核にたまり、核外輸送に欠陥。回復は PPIase: cpr1 deletion causes Zpr1 to accumulate in the nucleus, a defect in nuclear export. Rescue correlates with PPIase activity (12242280)
crd1Δ のミトコンドリアでは Ugo1・Scm4・Om14 の量が少なく、新: crd1Δ mitochondria have low levels of Ugo1, Scm4, and Om14 and a low capacity to import newly synthesized Ugo1 and Scm4 (26149385)
crd1Δ のミトコンドリアは新しく合成した Ugo1・Scm4 の取り込み能が: crd1Δ mitochondria have a low capacity to import newly synthesized Ugo1 and Scm4 (26149385)
crm1 変異体で Yap1 は常に核にあり、Crm1 は RanGTP 存在下: In crm1 mutants, Yap1 is constitutively nuclear, and Crm1 binds the NES-like sequence of Yap1 in the presence of RanGTP. Oxidation prevents recognition (9857197). Repressing Crm1 expression localizes Yap1 to the nucleus and induces its target genes. Yap1-Crm1 binding decreases under oxidative stress (9797454)
cse1 変異で Srp1 の再輸出と cNLS をもつ蛋白質の取り込みが阻まれ: cse1 mutations block re-export of Srp1 and import of cNLS-containing proteins (9744791). Cse1 prevents nuclear accumulation of Srp1 (9857050)
ctf19・mcm21 変異で Nkp2 が誤局在する（24385296）: Nkp2 is mislocalized in ctf19 and mcm21 mutants (24385296)
cwh41Δ で Kre6 が不安定になり、Kre6 の過剰発現で cwh41Δ: Kre6 becomes unstable in cwh41Δ, and Kre6 overexpression rescues the calcofluor sensitivity of cwh41Δ (9763440)
cyc8 の変異株では、Sko1 が制御する GRE2 と AHP1 がストレス: In cyc8 mutants, the Sko1-controlled genes GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed under unstressed conditions. By ChIP, Sko1-Tup1-Cyc8 is present at the GRE2 promoter (18201562)
In cyc8 mutants, the Sko1-controlled genes GRE2 and AHP1 are derepressed under unstressed conditions (18201562)
cym1Δ で Sod2 の活性が下がり、ミトコンドリアのタンパク質の酸化損傷が: cym1Δ reduces Sod2 activity and increases oxidative damage to mitochondrial proteins (30938873). CYM1 disruption causes MnSOD to contain subunits retaining the presequence (35997162)
cyt2 変異株はシトクロム c1 の中間体を貯め、CYT2 がシトクロム c1: cyt2 mutants accumulate a cytochrome c1 intermediate, and CYT2 encodes cytochrome c1 heme lyase (1499554). This enzyme is required for covalent attachment of heme to apocytochrome c1 (8082171)
dal80 変異株では誘導物質なしでも野生型の誘導時と同じ量の DUR1,2 R: In dal80 mutants, DUR1,2 RNA is present even without inducer at the same level as in induced wild type (3025621)
dal81 変異株では誘導下でも DUR1,2 の RNA がほぼ検出されない。: In dal81 mutants, DUR1,2 RNA is almost undetectable even under induction. DUR1,2 is transcriptionally controlled by DAL80 and DAL81 (3025621)
deh1(gzf3) 破壊株で DAL80 の発現が上がる（9171383）: DAL80 expression increases in deh1 (gzf3) disruptants (9171383)
deh1(gzf3) 破壊株で GAP1・DAL80・UGA4 の発現が上がり、: GAP1, DAL80, and UGA4 expression increases in deh1 (gzf3) disruptants, and Deh1 binds UGA4 and GAP1 promoter fragments. It acts only when glutamine is present (9171383)
deh1(gzf3) 破壊株で UGA4 の発現が上がり、Deh1 は UGA4: UGA4 expression increases in deh1 (gzf3) disruptants, and Deh1 binds a UGA4 promoter fragment (9171383)
dhh1 欠失で接合の転写因子 Ste12 のタンパク質量が大きく下がり接合が強: dhh1 deletion greatly reduces protein levels of the mating transcription factor Ste12 and strongly impairs mating, which is suppressed by overexpression of STE12 or CAF20 (18182159). The increase in Ste12 protein during filamentous growth is partially blocked in caf20 and dhh1 mutants, and both regulate STE12 translation (17041186)
djp1Δ でミトコンドリアの Mim1 が減り、過剰発現した GFP-Mim1: In djp1Δ, mitochondrial Mim1 decreases and overexpressed GFP-Mim1 mislocalizes to the ER (23959800)
dmc1Δ では Rad51 が積極的に抑えられ、この抑制は Mek1 に依存し: In dmc1Δ, Rad51 is actively inhibited; this inhibition depends on Mek1 and blocks Rad51-Rad54 complex formation by two mechanisms: Mek1 phosphorylation of Rad54 and binding of the meiosis-specific Hed1 to Rad51 (27483004)
dmo2 では Cox2 の分解が速く、Dmo2 は Cox2・Sco1・Sco: In dmo2, Cox2 is degraded rapidly, and Dmo2 coprecipitates with Cox2, Sco1, and Sco2 (39932033)
dot1 欠失では Rad9 と Rad53 の活性化が起こらず、DSB への: In dot1 deletion, Rad9 and Rad53 are not activated and Rad9 binding to DSBs decreases. dot1 deletion cells fail to activate the G1 and S phase checkpoints after irradiation (16166626). Binding of the Rad9 Tudor domain to methylated H3-K79 is required for checkpoint activation (17243194)
dph6 変異で eEF2 にジフチンがたまり、最後のアミド化ができない。Dph: In dph6 mutants, diphthine accumulates on eEF2 and the final amidation cannot occur. Dph6 binds eEF2 (23468660)
dun1 欠失で DIN7 の発現が上がる。Dun1 による抑制は DNA 損傷: dun1 deletion increases DIN7 expression. Repression by Dun1 is relieved by DNA damage (18540090)
eEF1B の γ サブユニット（TEF4・TEF3/CAM1）と α（TEF5: The γ subunits (TEF4, TEF3/CAM1) and α subunit (TEF5/EFB1) of eEF1B were found as multicopy suppressors of the synthetic growth defect of SUP45 and SUP35 mutations (19545407)
eEF1Bα は eEF1A からの GDP・GTP の解離を 320 倍・25: eEF1Bα accelerates dissociation of GDP and GTP from eEF1A by 320-fold and 250-fold, respectively (17925388)
eEF3 の過剰発現でアミノ酸飢餓での増殖と eIF2α のリン酸化が下がり、リ: eEF3 overexpression reduces growth under amino acid starvation and eIF2α phosphorylation, and worsens the phenotype of Gcn1-M7A, which has low ribosome affinity. eEF3 interferes with Gcn1 function on the ribosome (22888004)
eIF2(αP) による eIF2B の抑制を失わせる SUI2・GCD7 の変: SUI2 and GCD7 mutations that abolish inhibition of eIF2B by eIF2(αP) also impair binding of phosphorylated GST-SUI2 to the regulatory subunits (11438658)
eIF2A はエキソヌクレアーゼ Xrn1 などの mRNA 分解因子と物理的・: eIF2A is physically and functionally linked to mRNA decay factors such as the exonuclease Xrn1 (38011112)
eIF2A 複合体は Ssd1 と強く結合し、一部の mRNA への eIF2A: The eIF2A complex binds Ssd1 strongly, and eIF2A binding to some mRNAs is mediated by Ssd1. eIF2A represses translation of cell wall proteins (38011112)
eIF2B は eIF2 の GEF で、eIF2-GDP を活性型の eIF2: eIF2B is the GEF for eIF2, converting eIF2-GDP to active eIF2-GTP. The Gcd6 C-terminus is required for catalytic activity and eIF2 binding, and its mutation impairs the essential function of eIF2B (10805739). eIF2Bε is the only subunit with catalytic activity on its own (12356745)
eIF2α の Ser51 リン酸化（Asp 置換で模倣）が GCN4 の翻訳を: Ser51 phosphorylation of eIF2α (mimicked by Asp substitution) increases GCN4 translation. Classified as inhibit because GCN4 increases when eIF2 function decreases
